headline: EU-INDONESIA CEPA SIGNED
text: After 10 years of talks, the EU and Indonesia signed CEPA: 90.4% of Indonesian lines enter the EU duty-free, in force 2027.

headline: ESTONIA SHUTS RUSSIA BORDER
text: All road crossings close 1 December for six months after a GRU-linked arson attempt on drone maker Threod; rail runs on.

headline: TRUMP, XI, PUTIN MEET IN SHENZHEN
text: First-ever trilateral on the APEC sidelines; Kremlin says Ukraine topped the Trump-Putin bilateral. No breakthrough.

headline: THREE HOUTHI MISSILES DOWNED
text: Saudi-led coalition air defences destroyed three ballistic missiles fired toward the capital early Saturday.

headline: ANTHROPIC IPO FIZZLES
text: The record AI listing fell 9.1% to $88.30 on day two, barely above the $83 offer price, as the sell-off deepened.

headline: NVIDIA CEO EXIT ROCKS CHIPS
text: Jensen Huang's abrupt resignation deepened the rout: Nvidia down about 48% from its October peak, erasing ~$3 trillion.

headline: BRENT ENDS THIRD DOWN WEEK
text: Brent settled at $92.57 Friday, down 3.4% on the week, even as Hormuz traffic fell 20% in a fortnight.

headline: GULF WAR COST TOPS $48BN
text: The Pentagon told lawmakers the Iran war has cost the US military over $48 billion since February.

headline: UKRAINE DOWNS 161 OF 186 DRONES
text: Air defences neutralised 161 of 186 attack drones overnight Saturday, after days of massed barrages.

headline: PERU M5.0 AFTERSHOCK
text: A magnitude 5.0 tremor at 108 km depth struck 15 km from Carhuamayo early Sunday, after the M6.7 main shock.

headline: COP31 LONGEST SUMMIT ON RECORD
text: Two days of overtime made COP31 the longest UN climate summit ever — and still it ended without a text.

headline: QATAR MEDIATES IN TEHRAN
text: A Qatari delegation visited Tehran Friday as Iran called Hormuz talks 'pointless' until its demands are met.
